name: White Dragon (Adult) OLD

generalAbilities.name: Snow Vision
generalAbilities.description: Snow doesn't impair a white dragon's vision; it ignores concealment from snowfall.

savenote: +1 status to all saves vs. magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Dragon Chill
defensiveAbilities.description: 5 feet. 2d6 Cold Damage damage (Basic DC 27 Reflex Saving Throw save)

defensiveAbilities.name: Freezing Blood
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger An adjacent creature deals piercing or slashing damage to the dragon.

Effect The dragon's blood sprays on the creature, dealing 2d6 Cold Damage damage. A creature that takes cold damage in this way is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
90 feet. DC 27 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Weapon
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon breathes a cloud of frost that deals 11d6 Cold Damage damage in a 40ft Cone (Basic DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save).

It can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order

offensiveAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
offensiveAbilities.description: When the dragon scores a critical hit with a Strike, it recharges its Breath Weapon

offensiveAbilities.name: Ground Slam
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon slams into the ground. It can do this if it's on the ground or Flying within 10 feet of the ground. Each creature on the ground within 10 feet must succeed at a DC 29 Reflex Saving Throw save or fall Prone and take 3d6 Bludgeoning Damage damage.

The dragon can then Step.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ice Climb
offensiveAbilities.description: A white dragon can climb on ice as though it had the listed climb Speed. It ignores difficult terrain and greater difficult terrain from ice and snow and doesn't risk falling when crossing ice.

offensiveAbilities.name: Shape Ice
offensiveAbilities.description:
The dragon reshapes a cube of ice or snow it touches, up to 10 feet across. Any creature standing atop the ice must succeed at a DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save or DC 15 Acrobatics check.

On a failure, the creature falls Prone atop the ice; on a critical failure, it falls off the ice entirely and is also prone.

lv1spells.name: Gust of Wind (At Will)
lv1spells.duration: until the start of your next turn
lv1spells.description:
A violent wind issues forth from your palm, blowing from the point where you are when you cast the spell to the line's opposite end. The wind extinguishes small non-magical fires, disperses fog and mist, blows objects of light Bulk or less around, and pushes larger objects. Large or smaller creatures in the area must attempt a Fortitude save. Large or smaller creatures that later move into the gust must attempt the save on entering.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature can't move against the wind.

Failure The creature is knocked Prone. If it was flying, it suffers the effects of critical failure instead.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed 30 feet in the wind's direction, knocked Prone, and takes 2d6 bludgeoning damage.

lv2spells.name: Obscuring Mist (At Will)
lv2spells.description: You call forth a cloud of mist. All creatures within the mist become Concealed, and all creatures outside the mist become Concealed to creatures within it. You can Dismiss the cloud.
